source.title: Trade-Based Money Laundering: Trends and Developments

summary: The report sets out how criminals exploit international trade to move value, describing invoice manipulation, phantom shipments and the use of front companies across multiple jurisdictions. It emphasises the role of documentary review and cross-border information sharing.

typologies.label: Over and under invoicing of goods

citations.quote: Over-invoicing and under-invoicing of goods remains the most common TBML technique observed.
Several jurisdictions reported the misuse of carbon credit trading to legitimise proceeds.

actors.name: Professional money launderers
actors.role: Specialists who take receipt of criminal proceeds and move them through trade

citations.quote: PMLs offer specialist expertise using a range of ML techniques to diversify their risk exposure.

actors.name: Example Trading FZE
actors.role: Intermediary re-invoicing goods between related parties

citations.quote: A free zone entity acted as an intermediary, re-invoicing the same consignment three times.

indicators.description: Unit prices on invoices materially outside published market ranges for the commodity

citations.quote: Prices that deviate significantly from market benchmarks should prompt further enquiry.

extraction_notes: Actor name is illustrative in the source; treat as pattern not designation.
